## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what this change does.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Explain any check that could not run.

## Documentation and compatibility

Note any public API, parameter, dependency, error, or server-compatibility changes. Link relevant documentation updates and add an Unreleased changelog entry when appropriate.

Do not include API keys, private uploads, or credentials. Use SECURITY.md for vulnerability reports.
